# Yundera/AppStore — Prowlarr

**Verdict: ERRORED · top severity Major · risk_score 13**

*Audit date:* 2026-08-06 · *Store version:* `lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:2.4.0` · *Compose blob sha:* `eac8444b8965343a28a63566f3cf1e49c0867ab9` (last touched commit `0f5955e3e243`, 2026-07-10) · *Ref:* `main` · *Scope:* `n-a` (no compose_base) · *Depth:* full (functional leg could not run)

`errored` is used per the orchestrator Amendment §B4/§E: infra genuinely blocked every mandatory functional phase. **This is not a verdict about the app** — Prowlarr is not blamed for the demo-host outage. The static leg completed in full and its findings are reported below and stand on their own.

---

## Functionality

**Demo host selected: **`demostaging1.inojob.com`**.** Selection followed the binding 2026-07-17 amendment: the Demo Management board showed `demostaging1` = **✅ Ready, 8.0h remaining** (next cleanup 2026-08-06 17:00) and `demostaging2` = **🔄 Processing, 24.0h** — `demostaging2` is mid-cleanup and is therefore ineligible regardless of its time remaining. `demostaging1` was the **only** qualifying instance (Ready, > 1h). `🧹 Trigger Cleanup` was never clicked on either card.

**Every mandatory phase errored: the session could never be established, because the demo host rejects every published credential.** Evidence gathered:

| Auth path | Credentials | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Local Account (Authelia) | `demo` / `demodemo` (protocol default) | `POST /api/firstfactor` → **401** |
| Local Account (Authelia) | `demo@yundera.com` / `Demo123!` (live banner creds) | `POST /api/firstfactor` → **401** |
| Local Account (Authelia) | `demo` / `Demo123!` (mixed) | `POST /api/firstfactor` → **401** |
| Yundera Login (Firebase IdP) | `demo@yundera.com` / `Demo123!` | `Firebase: The supplied auth credential is incorrect, malformed or has expired. (auth/invalid-credential)` |

The protocol's documented `demo`/`demodemo` pair is **stale** — the live banner at `app.nasselle.com/demo/` now advertises `demo@yundera.com` / `Demo123!` ("Resets in 7.8h, 15:00 UTC"). Those advertised credentials fail too, on **both independent identity providers** (local Authelia *and* the upstream Firebase-backed Yundera IdP). All static assets and `/api/state` returned 200, so the host itself is up — this is a credential/identity-store failure, not a dead host. Four fresh OIDC flows were tried across three isolated browser contexts to rule out a stale `flow_id`; the shared CDP browser additionally reset its page set twice mid-run and was recovered each time, so the browser was **not** the blocker. This reproduces a previously recorded outage of the same signature (401 at `/api/firstfactor` for all credentials on both demo hosts, 2026-08-05).

| Phase | Result | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A — Session | **errored** | Login impossible; 401 / `auth/invalid-credential` on both IdPs, all credential sets. |
| C — Fresh install (+duration) | **errored** | Unreachable — dashboard never loaded. No install duration recorded. |
| D — Discover app URL | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| E8 — Works immediately | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| E9 — Auth gate | **errored** | Unreachable — the check that would have settled the reverse-proxy bypass advisory above. |
| E10 — Clean boot | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| F — Zero-config usability | **errored** | Unreachable. |
| G — Data persistence (real uninstall-keep-data → reinstall) | **errored** | Unreachable. Not "not-attempted" and not skipped for cost: the session prerequisite failed. The static persistence cross-check (above) did pass, but it is **not** a substitute for Phase G. |
| G′ — Migration | **n-a** | No `PRIOR_VERSION` supplied (audit of a single current version) — the one legitimate `n-a` per the strict-full-run amendment. |

**Functional verdict:** `errored` (infra). Per the amendment, an errored mandatory phase can never yield `compliant`, and the cause split assigns this to infra — the app is not blamed.

### Cleanup

**Nothing to uninstall — obligation satisfied.** The session never authenticated, so Prowlarr was never installed on `demostaging1`; no app, no state and no configuration was created by this run. The instance is left exactly as found. No cleanup was triggered on either instance.

---

## Bottom line

The audit **could not complete**, so the headline is `errored` and a retry is required once demo-host authentication is restored. What the static leg does establish is worth acting on independently:

- **Fix first (Major):** add `Apps/Prowlarr/rationale.md` documenting the reliance on Prowlarr's first-launch auth onboarding — and, while writing it, confirm the app actually presents a login gate through the Caddy proxy rather than treating proxied traffic as local. If it does not, this is a **Critical** exposure on a publicly-routable host, not a paperwork gap.
- **Then (Minor ×3):** raise `cpu_shares` off the reserved `10` tier (ideally across the whole *arr family at once), ship a distinct `thumbnail.png` instead of a copy of `icon.png`, and add per-volume/per-env descriptions to `x-casaos`.
- **Retry blocker:** the functional leg needs working demo credentials. The protocol's `demo`/`demodemo` default should be updated to read the live banner, though today even the banner credentials are rejected — this is an infra fix, not an audit-config fix.
